Name: (Completed) Misterghostfrogs portrait overhaul
Author: Misterghostfrog
Description:
A complete portrait replacment mod, changing every in game character portrait available to my own versions.

[u][b]Major edits include:[/b][/u]

Short-haired Penny

Natural haired and slightly darker skinned Maru, plus replacing her nurses outfit with scrubs (Thank you to[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/58947071] [/url][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/58947071-cherrysymphony/]CherrySymphony[/url] for allowing me to use her sprite edit, which you can find [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2903]here[/url])

Reasonable hairstyle having Sam

Smaller bow for Jas

Undercut for Sebastian

And Tan Alex

[u]To install:

[/u][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Download the mod and unzip it into your mods folder
[*]Done!
[/list]
[u]Latest update now includes update key

EDIT: Sorry about the long time since an update, I forgot i'd made this! Thank you to the person who hunted down my youtube last year and asked very politely, I just found that message looking through that channel and thought i'd fix this for anyone who wanted to use it! 

Note, there won't be a seasons version of this like i'd planned. I never got the time to work on it and now my art style's changed enough that I don't think i'll be messing with it anytime soon. Thanks to anyone who was interested, and sorry!
[/u]
